items.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the user's pro-rata share of the expiry epoch's rewards; pro_rata_share_final_epoch is a symbolic reference quantity grounded only by the intent statement.
Report does not state whether the user actually calls claimRewards or whether the zero epoch-end snapshot alone determines the loss.

Report does not give a numeric formula for the pro-rata share (bonded duration vs epoch length vs total epoch rewards); pro_rata_share is bound symbolically and its exact derivation is deferred to code binding.
